recentItems.title: Beyond the Crash
recentItems.description:
Netflix’s The Crash has brought renewed attention to one of the most shocking criminal cases in recent memory. But beyond the headlines, the courtroom drama, and the documentary are the families still living with the loss.

In this episode, Lynden Blake sits down with Christine Russo, the sister of Dominic Russo, one of the two young men killed in the 2022 Strongsville, Ohio crash. Christine opens up about grief, remembering her brother, participating in the Netflix documentary, and her family’s fight to pass Dom and Davion’s Law.

This is a conversation about loss, resilience, and making sure the victims are never forgotten.

Ep. 15

recentItems.title: Overboard: Goodbye Soulmate
recentItems.description:
A somber Mother’s Day for the family of Lynette Hooker, the Michigan Mom, who has been missing for more than five weeks now in the Bahamas.

"It's the first mother's day without my Mom. It's pretty hard right now to know that she's not a text away anymore," Karli Aylesworth, Lynette's daughter, shared in a post Sunday.
As Brian hooker remains M.I.A., is the couple’s sailboat "Soulmate" now a crime scene?

What evidence, if any, on that boat could break the case and bring Lynette home?

That's So Criminal with Lynden Blake dives into the latest in this ongoing U.S. Coast Guard criminal investigation.
